item.title: ALC Bangalore
item.description:
Bangalore (officially Bengaluru) is the capital of the southern Indian state of Karnataka, known as the “Silicon Valley of India” as the nation’s leading software exporter and a major semiconductor hub.

See the chapter’s wiki page for current organizers, events, and reports. To reach the chapter, email dev@community.apache.org with [Bangalore] in the subject line.

item.title: ALC Ghana
item.description:
ALC Ghana is a proposed chapter put forward in August 2026, with Rich Bowen mentoring. The proposal aims to bring open source mentorship, technical workshops, and collaboration with local universities and tech communities to the region. As of early October 2026 it was moving toward approval on the ComDev list but had not been formally finalized.

See the proposal thread on dev@community for details. To reach the organizers, email dev@community.apache.org with [ALC] in the subject line.
